_comment: False-positive attractors that must produce nothing, and one real defect that must. The four notes carry [[500, 375]] in a python fence, [[wikilinks]] in inline code, a tilde fence, a markdown link written [[1](url)], a colon and a hash inside quoted scalars — all of which a naive scanner reports as links. The orphan is the other direction: it is listed in structure/index.md, and index links are excluded from the inbound count, so being indexed does not make it linked.
